'''''Miltonia flavescens''''', the '''yellowish miltonia''', is a species of [[orchid]] occurring in southern [[Brazil]], northeastern [[Argentina]], and [[Paraguay]], and has been reported from eastern [[Peru]].<ref>{{cite book |title= The Illustrated encyclopedia of orchids|last= Pridgeon|first= Alec M. |year= 1992|publisher= [[Timber Press]]|isbn= 978-0-88192-267-7|page= 178|url= https://books.google.com/books?id=BP4antrlNRAC}}</ref>
